audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer correctly calls this a losing lane at 38.1%, but the full layer's tldr and winCon say the opposite: 'you poke forever — survive the early chip and the treadmill out-grinds him' and 'Outlast the burst poke and grind him down'. The two layers describe different matchups.
audit.why: 38.1% over 42 games, with Ziggs holding five of the seven chart stages, is not a lane you grind out. The full-layer strings look like the generic Cassiopeia treadmill boilerplate that was never adjusted for an artillery mage you cannot reach.
audit.corrected: Rewrote tldr and winCon to match the content layer: survive, punish one misstep, play for a level 6 pick.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one cooldown appears anywhere despite Satchel Charge being named the matchup-defining ability in the full layer.
audit.why: Bouncing Bomb 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s, Satchel Charge 20/18/16/14/12s, Hexplosive Minefield 16s flat, Mega Inferno Bomb 120/95/70s. His entire lane is a rotation of cooldowns you have to wait out, so the numbers are the advice.
audit.corrected: Added the 20s Satchel, 6s Bouncing Bomb and 16s Minefield to the cooldown breakdown and the level 6 want.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three places state that Bouncing Bomb out-ranges Noxious Blast. It does not — both are 850. The real range problem is stated nowhere: Twin Fang is 700, so even a landed Noxious Blast cannot be cashed unless he steps 150 units closer than his own poke requires, and Hexplosive Minefield (900) and Satchel Charge (1000) do out-range everything you own.
audit.why: Riot ranges: Ziggs Q 850, E 900, W 1000, R 5000; Cassiopeia Q 850, W 700, E 700, R 825. Telling the reader his Q out-ranges her Q is a checkable falsehood that also hides the true mechanic — the gap is between her Q and her own E.
audit.corrected: Replaced the false Q-vs-Q claim with the Q-850-to-E-700 gap and named Minefield and Satchel as the abilities that genuinely out-reach you.

audit.why: Worth recording as verified: the guide's claim that a Ziggs holds Satchel Charge to knock himself out of a Miasma is consistent with Riot's text — 'Ziggs is also knocked away, but takes no damage' — and Satchel is his only repositioning tool, which is why baiting it is the whole level 6 plan. I kept that and only attached the 20s number.

edits.before: Ziggs out-ranges you instantly — his Bouncing Bomb (Q) chunks you the second you step up to last-hit, while your Noxious Blast (Q) needs him inside ~850 range he never gives. You bleed HP for every CS.
edits.after: The range problem is not his Q — Bouncing Bomb and Noxious Blast are both 850. It is that Twin Fang only reaches 700, so you poison him and never cash it, while Minefield (900) and Satchel (1000) reach past you.

edits.before: Ziggs' Bouncing Bomb (Q) out-ranges your Noxious Blast and pokes you for free — at level 1 with one ability you cannot answer his range at all.
edits.after: Bouncing Bomb matches your Q at 850, but Twin Fang reaches only 700 — you can poison him and still never cash the fangs, and at 1 you cannot answer that.

edits.before: Poke you with Bouncing Bomb (Q) every time you walk up to CS and seed Minefield (E) on your approach paths to deny engage
edits.after: Poke with Bouncing Bomb (Q, 6s) every time you step up to CS and seed Minefield (E, 16s) at 900 range on your approach paths

edits.before: Hit 6 and bait out his Satchel Charge (W) before committing a Petrifying Gaze (R) all-in when he steps up to shove
edits.after: Hit 6 and bait out his Satchel Charge, 20s at rank 1, before committing a Petrifying Gaze all-in when he shoves

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are miserable and you have to accept it. His Bouncing Bomb (Q) out-ranges your Noxious Blast (Q) and pokes you for free every time you walk into last-hit range, and at level 1 with one ability you simply cannot answer it — your poison needs him inside roughly 850 units and he never has to be there. Don't try to trade Qs, you lose every exchange. Instead lean on your Serpentine Grace move speed and Noxious Blast's speed boost to weave behind minions and break his Q bounce-line, last-hit at max range, and stay out of any thrown Satchel zone. Your only goal these levels is to not fall behind in HP and survive to your level-6 all-in.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are miserable and you have to accept it. Bouncing Bomb (Q) is 850 range, exactly the same as your Noxious Blast — the gap that actually kills you is Twin Fang at 700, so you can land poison and still have nothing to cash it with, while Minefield (900) and Satchel (1000) reach past both. Do not try to trade Qs, you lose every exchange. Instead lean on your Serpentine Grace move speed and Noxious Blast's speed boost to weave behind minions and break his Q bounce-line, last-hit at max range, and stay out of any thrown Satchel zone. Your only goal these levels is to not fall behind in HP and survive to your level-6 all-in.

edits.before: He pokes in bursts, you poke forever — survive the early chip and the treadmill out-grinds him.
edits.after: He out-ranges you and you cannot answer it — survive the chip and play for a level 6 pick.

edits.before: Outlast the burst poke and grind him down with the treadmill. Keep one eye on Satchel Charge and one on the wave, in that order.
edits.after: Survive the poke, punish one misstep with Miasma, and end it at 6. Keep one eye on Satchel Charge and one on the wave.

edits.before: Q-poison his last-hit, E twice on the poison timer, drop W as he steps at you, and walk the grounded zone's edge while the fangs finish the math.
edits.after: Q-poison him only when you can follow it — Twin Fang reaches 700 to his Q's 850, so the fangs need him closer than his poke ever brings him.

edits.before: Spamming E without poison until your mana bar dies — and then standing in Satchel Charge range with Miasma on cooldown.
edits.after: Spamming E without poison until your mana bar dies — or stepping into Bouncing Bomb range with nothing to punish it with.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - W Miasma is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — 20s at rank 1, his knockback escape; he is catchable only while it is down. - Bouncing Bomb is 6s and Hexplosive Minefield 16s. - W Miasma is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it.

notes: 42 games is the thinnest sample in this slice — the 38.1% is real data but soft. The Twin Fang range gap (700 against his 850 Q) is the actual reason this lane is unwinnable in the early game and it was not stated anywhere; the guide instead repeated a false claim that his Q out-ranges hers.
